## 💡 Feature Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or clinical limitation? Please describe.
*(e.g., I'm frustrated when monitoring ambulatory HF patients because...)*

## 📐 Proposed Solution & Clinical Workflow
Describe the solution and how it integrates into the clinical workstation.
- Which workspace is affected? (e.g. Cohort, Organ Twin, Renal, GDMT, Agent Trace)
- What clinical guidelines or evidence ground this enhancement? (e.g. 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA)

## ⚖️ Safety & Invariant Considerations
Does this feature affect deterministic safety guardrails, lab recency rules, or prescribing ceremonies?

## 🔍 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've evaluated.
